messages:
jonathan: Kicked off quant sensitivity sweep for tessellate v1.0 on staging. Ran fp16 / int8(sym) / int8(per-channel) / int6. Short summary: int8-per-channel is within noise vs fp16; int6 loses recall@1 on short queries. UMAP shows some cluster merging for longtail. Posting numbers and next steps.

maya: Can you paste the recall@k and silhouette numbers?

jonathan: Sure — raw snapshot from eval harness (holdout=wiki+cc, hard-neg sampling enabled):
```
model                quant        recall@1  recall@5  silhouette
tessellate-v1        fp16         0.824     0.912     0.214
tessellate-v1        int8         0.819     0.908     0.198
tessellate-v1        int8-perch   0.821     0.910     0.205
tessellate-v1        int6         0.792     0.885     0.132
baseline-oracle      fp16         0.835     0.919     0.221
```
Numbers are average over 3 seeds. recall@1 drop for int6 concentrated on queries <=10 tokens.

sofi: ugh int6 drop is nontrivial for short queries. Do we have query-length breakdown?

jonathan: yes — quick bins:
- <=10 tokens: 28% of holdout, recall@1 fp16=0.840, int6=0.798 (delta -0.042)
- 11-50 tokens: 54%, delta -0.018
- >50 tokens: 18%, delta -0.011

ops-bot: deploy-stats: staging group tessellate-v1 x3 replicas, p95 latency fp16=14ms, int8=12ms, int6=10ms. No OOMs.

maya: For production, I'd prefer int8-perchannel if cost matters. Can we try per-channel int8 calibration with asymmetric quant (symmetric gave worse for a few anchors)?

jonathan: Agreed. I'm scheduling a rerun with per-channel asymmetric and also adding a hard-neg heavy holdout (tail-heavy). Will attach run id once complete.

sofi: Also let's add a quick cluster-level sanity: compute neighbor-preservation (top10) and silhouette delta. If neighbor-preservation drops >3% for any cohort, abort canary.

maya: I'll add routing rule for canary to route short queries (<=12 tokens) to fp16 variant until we validate int6.
jonathan: Added rule to canary config:
`if request.tokens <= 12 => model=tessellate-v1-fp16 else model=tessellate-v1-int8-perch`

jonathan: Created ticket RDW-45612 (embed-onboard/tessellate/quant) with tasks: rerun per-channel-asym, add hard-neg holdout, compute neighbor-preservation, add eval plots. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sofi: Sounds good. :thumbsup: Leaving triage open — will re-evaluate after per-channel-asym run.

maya: Thanks — ping me when run id is up.

ops-bot: evaluation-complete: run t-6999999 — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/tessellate/t-6999999
